summary: Before /auto retrospective, `roadmap.md` existed only under `.claude/commands/`; OpenCode and Copilot prompt mirrors were missing until `python3 scripts/azoth-deploy.py` ran (78 files). Risk class: any new slash command without a deploy pass leaves cross-IDE parity broken.
